comment: The jack below the Octave knob carries no printing; the manual's opening section says every unlabelled jack is the CV input for the parameter beside it. Slap.cpp:102 multiplies the 1V-per-octave ratio by 4, which is the two octaves above the recorded rate mentioned in the notes; the manual does not say so. The 440ms maximum decay is the sample's own length, 19424 frames at 44.1kHz (SlapSamples.hpp), which is what Slap.cpp:25 computes; the manual's 440ms agrees. Index order is not panel order here: input 4 is the topmost jack and input 0 the one under it.
